text:
alice: heads-up, starting intake for marigold-8b quant smoke. saw some weird token drift when running long-context QA. filing here for visibility.

ben: ok — can you paste the failing example and model config?

alice: minimal repro: 8k context, quant INT8 with per-channel quant, rope-mode=rotary. short prompt then continuation loses coherency after ~1k tokens. logs + artefacts: s3://redwood-testing/marigold8b/2026-03-17.zip

carla: interesting. did you try disabling rope or switching to scaled-rope? last time we saw token drift it was RoPE frequency mismatch between compiled kernels and model params.

alice: not yet. running two forks now: (1) runtime compiled with legacy-rope kernels, (2) runtime with new rope-freq-fix. will compare.

ben: throw perf numbers too when you have them. want both latency and p50/p95 throughput and a quick eval on HELM/QA devset.

alice: quick smoke results:
```
model: marigold-8b-quant-int8
setup: 1xA100-80G, batch=1, seq=2048->8192 (streaming)
latency p50: 85ms token
latency p95: 420ms token
throughput (tokens/s): 11.3
quality (qa-f1): 0.72 (baseline float16: 0.78)
```
notable: drift at ~1200 tokens only on INT8+rotary. float16 + same runtime is fine.

dave: do you have KV cache mismatch traces? sounds like the kv offsets might be getting folded incorrectly with quantized matmul reorder.

alice: added log snippet from run where the answer goes off:
```
[2026-03-17T15:12:03Z] decode_step=1195 kv_cache.shape=(8,1,64,1024)
[2026-03-17T15:12:03Z] rotary_phase=0.8723 expected_phase=0.8723
[2026-03-17T15:12:04Z] attn_logits_peak_idx=0 attn_weight_sum=0.0003  <-- suspicious low mass
[2026-03-17T15:12:04Z] output_token="the" -> "and" -> later nonsense
```

carla: thanks. that low attn_mass suggests the keys/queries scale or rotation mismatched. can you run with `--dump-head=0` to inspect head 0 kv vectors before/after quant path?

alice: running now. also trying recompile with `--rope-scale=1.0` vs `--rope-scale=0.5` (we recently introduced learned scaling).

ben: prioritization note: is this a showstopper for marigold on Hosted? if so bump to P1 for eng-runtime.

alice: for now P2 — low customer impact, internal perf test only — but will go P1 if repro on float16 or other quant configs.

infra-bot: deploy_job #3421 started: runtime-build-marigold-ropefix -> runners/qa-1

eval-bot: quick eval completed (devset small):
- baseline-fp16: exact_match=0.65
- quant-int8: exact_match=0.58
- quant-int8 + rope-fix-kernel: exact_match=0.63
artifacts: s3://redwood-testing/marigold8b/evals/2026-03-17/

dave: nice improvement with rope-fix. we should add a unit test that compares KV vectors between quant path and fp16 for N steps and head samples. catches early regressions.

carla: agreed. checklist for onboarding marigold-8b (short):
- build kernels with explicit rope-freq from model config
- run kv-consistency test (dump first 4 heads)
- run quant-accuracy sweep (per-channel vs per-tensor)
- canary: 10% traffic on Dedicated, monitor attn_mass + perplexity window
- rollback path ready (pin to fp16 image)

alice: adding those to intake doc and tagging runtime team. putting a short canary playbook in the PR.

ben: thanks. once you have distilled repro steps and a small failing prompt set, we can add to Optimize's regression alerts to catch future regressions automatically.

alice: will do. sharing repro prompt here in case anyone wants to run locally:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the following legal clause step-by-step: <long clause text elided>"
Expected style: structured numbered steps.
Repro token index where drift starts: ~1196
```

carla: ping me when you have the KV dumps. I'll write the unit test.

alice: will drop KV dumps and a short note in the PR by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:
